aaSequenceIds.description: IDs of AA sequences to back-translate.

avoidedCutsiteEnzymeIds.description: List of enzyme IDs whose recognition sites will be avoided when creating the back-translated sequence.

codonUsageTableId.description: ID of the codon usage table representing the target organism.

folderId.description: ID of the folder in which the back-translated sequences will be saved.

gcContent.description: The amount of GC content in the optimized sequence. LOW is defined as below 0.33, MEDIUM as 0.33-0.66, and HIGH as above 0.66. If neither gcContent nor gcContentRange is specified, the optimization will default to ANY (0-1). Cannot be specified together with gcContentRange.

gcContentRange.description: Custom GC content range for the optimized sequence, specified as decimal values between 0 and 1. The maximum must be greater than the minimum. Cannot be specified together with gcContent.

hairpinParameters.description: These parameters are applied in the AvoidHairpins specification in DNAChisel. If hairpinParameters is not specified, hairpins will not be avoided.

method.description: The codon optimization algorithm to use. Requires codonUsageTableId to be specified. MATCH_CODON_USAGE selects codons probabilistically based on the organism's codon usage frequencies. USE_BEST_CODON always selects the most frequently used codon for each amino acid.

reducedPatterns.description: List of patterns to avoid when creating the back-translated sequence, on the coding strand only.

schemaId.description: ID of the resulting DNA sequences' schemas

shouldDepleteUridine.description: If not specified, the back-translation will default to false, and mRNA uridine depletion will not be performed.

ReducedPattern.description:
DNA patterns to avoid during optimization. Supports two formats: 1) DNA base patterns: strings of ATGC bases (case-insensitive, e.g., "ATGC" or "gat") 2) Repeat patterns: format "nxkmer" specifying n repeats of k-sized sequences (e.g., "3x4mer" matches 3 consecutive 4-base repeats). Maximum total length for repeat patterns is 50 bases (n * k ≤ 50).
If avoidReverseComplement is true, the pattern's reverse complement will also be avoided. Note: avoidReverseComplement cannot be true for repeat patterns (nxkmer format).
